findings.finding: HTTP 402 maps to PROVIDER_PLAN_REQUIRED for every provider kind. The official WB seller-info docs identify 402 as Payment required, but this implementation also applies that diagnostic to Ozon Seller and Performance endpoints without a provider-specific documented 402 contract. This may mislabel unrelated upstream responses as a plan/payment restriction.
findings.recommendation: Restrict PROVIDER_PLAN_REQUIRED to provider/method combinations with documented 402 semantics (at minimum WB seller-info); map unqualified Ozon 402 responses to CHECK_UNAVAILABLE. Keep payment or plan remediation entirely outside this check.
